subject: Recap + proposed decision timeline & owners — NovaHQ exploratory call
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@novahq.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@echohealth.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0500
Subject: Recap + proposed decision timeline & owners — NovaHQ exploratory call

Emma / Carlos — great to meet earlier. Short recap from my side and a proposed mutual action plan so we stay aligned. I pulled the items we discussed into a one-page MAP (attached) and short next steps below.

Pain points we heard
- Unreliable latency on small-context prompts — customer-facing product experiences jitter at scale.
- Cost per 1k queries is rising with current provider and caching is inconsistent across sessions.
- Compliance: need audit log retention and optional VPC for PHI-sensitive routes.

Goals we discussed
- Reduce median latency for the chat endpoint from ~420ms to <150ms under normal load.
- Achieve ~30% reduction in per-token cost through batching/caching and a quantization strategy.
- Proof-of-concept (PoC) with guarded PHI subset inside a VPC or dedicated pool.

Proposed MAP (high level) — dates are flexible, please adjust
1) Technical scoping & success metrics — owner: Carlos (NovaHQ) / Vivek (Redwood) — by 2026-02-20
2) PoC environment up (dedicated pool, VPC option) — owner: Markus (Redwood infra) / Nova infra lead — by 2026-03-05
3) PoC run & metric review (latency, cost, quality) — owner: Carlos / Laura (Redwood CSM) — by 2026-03-19
4) Procurement & contract (if PoC acceptable) — owner: Emma (NovaHQ procurement) / Vivek — target decision by 2026-03-31

Decision process (as I understood it)
- Technical sign-off: Nova infra + product (Carlos + 2 engineers)
- Commercial sign-off: Procurement (Emma) and VP Product for final approval

Immediate next steps (my commits)
- Share the MAP PDF + draft pricing sheet (attached) — sent with this thread.
- Set up a 90-minute PoC kickoff workshop (ops + infra) — proposed week of 2/23.

Could you confirm: (1) owners above look right, (2) the proposed dates are realistic, and (3) who on NovaHQ will be the infra contact for the VPC/dedicated pool setup?

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Li <emma@novahq.com>

Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@echohealth.io>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed decision timeline & owners — NovaHQ exploratory call

Thanks Vivek — helpful summary and nice layout on the MAP. Quick responses below and a couple of clarifications.

Owners:
- Technical lead: Carlos + myself as product owner (we'll also loop in our infra lead, Priya Shah — cc'ing her now: priya.shah@novahq.com).
- Procurement: that's me. Commercial/finance sign-off is with our VP of Finance (Maya Rios).

Dates: overall timeline looks reasonable but can we shift the PoC kickoff one week later? Our infra team is in a heavy release on 2/23. Suggested kickoff window: week of 3/2, PoC run 3/9–3/20. Final decision window moves to ~4/7 to give Finance time for review.

Scope tweaks: we want the PoC to include a small sample of historical sessions (redacted) so we can validate caching behavior. We'll send an SFTP credential for transfer if that works. Also we need confirmation on data retention window options (30/90/365 days) for audit logs — can you include those permutations in the PoC config?

Next steps from NovaHQ:
- I'll introduce Priya (infra) and Maya (finance) to this thread.
- Carlos will send a short list of the 3 product tests they want run during the PoC by EOD Wed (2/18).

If that all sounds good we can lock the kickoff for Tue 3/3 at 11am PT — Carlos, can you confirm?

— Emma
Emma Li

> If that all sounds good we can lock the kickoff for Tue 3/3 at 11am PT — Carlos, can you confirm?

Confirming 3/3 11am PT works for me. I'll put together the 3 test cases (latency baseline, cache-replay, cost-per-1k estimate) and send them by EOD Wed. Priya — would you be able to join the kickoff for infra questions?

Couple items for Redwood to prepare for the kickoff:
- Brief runbook for VPC/dedicated pool setup and sample IAM roles
- PoC config options for audit log retention (30/90/365) and how logs are exported
- A minimal data-handling checklist for the redacted sessions upload (SFTP instructions)

Thanks — Carlos

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Thanks all — looping in early so PoC support stays coordinated. A few operational notes from Redwood CSM side:
- I'll schedule the kickoff and include the PoC success metrics template so Carlos can populate the three tests.
- I'll create a shared Drive folder (link will follow) for artifacts and test results; prefer Drive over email attachments for versioning.
- On billing: if NovaHQ wants to convert to Dedicated after PoC we can provide a short-term reserve quote for the trial period to stabilize cost while Finance reviews. Vivek — I'll work with you on that quote draft after the PoC run.

See you Tue 3/3 11am PT (tentative) — Laura
